Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Sources of Disagreement in Data for LLM Instruction Tuning (acl.2025.comedi-1.3) · paper method: On the full human dataset, quadratic-weighted kappa is 0.48 for SINGLE ratings and 0.43 for PREFERENCE combined scores; the authors find no evidence in this setup that preference annotation is easier or less ambiguous.

Permanent record ID: cohort3.claim.disagreement.agreement-not-superiority

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Sources of Disagreement in Data for LLM Instruction Tuning (acl.2025.comedi-1.3) · paper method: Across the two human task formulations, the study reports instance-level disagreement correlation R=0.2 and ambiguity-set overlap 0.25, despite using the same annotators and data points.

Permanent record ID: cohort3.claim.disagreement.instance-disagreement

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.
  • This is a result for the studied population, generic quality instructions and sample; it does not establish all disagreement as noise.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Sources of Disagreement in Data for LLM Instruction Tuning (acl.2025.comedi-1.3) · paper method: The zero-shot annotation experiment uses four instruction-tuned models from 1B to 8B; the 1B model has no reported human-label correlation, while the other three have correlation in 0.2–0.25.

Permanent record ID: cohort3.claim.disagreement.llm-scope

  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific author-reported study; experiments, raw dataset records and formal proofs were not independently reproduced or verified.
  • The paper acknowledges that prompting, sampling and larger models may improve results; this does not characterize every LLM evaluator.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

Sources of Disagreement in Data for LLM Instruction Tuning (acl.2025.comedi-1.3) · paper method: The human experiment selects720 Anthropic context/two-response instances, evenly split between helpful and harmless, and recruits 33 graduate-course annotators to perform both individual 1–5 quality ratings and paired preference/magnitude tasks.

Permanent record ID: cohort3.claim.disagreement.matched-design
